automation.yaml:
- id: example_automation_001
  alias: 3D Print Done
  initial_state: true
  trigger:
    trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.example_3d_printer_printing
    from: 'on'
    to: 'off'
  action:
  - action: secret notification_service
    data:
      message: 3D Print Complete

natural_language.trigger: When the example 3D printer printing [binary_sensor.example_3d_printer_printing] sensor changes its state from 'on' (printing) to 'off' (not printing).
natural_language.action: Sends a notification via an anonymized notification service with the message '3D Print Complete'.

functional.human_like: Sends a notification when the 3D printer finishes a job.
functional.structured_description: TRIGGER: When example 3D printer printing [binary_sensor.example_3d_printer_printing] changes from on to off. CONDITIONS: None. ACTIONS: Send a notification through an anonymized service with the text '3D Print Complete'.

security.description: The rule only reports the operational status of a 3D printer and does not involve personal data or security-relevant devices. It introduces no physical, privacy, or cybersecurity risk.

goal_classes.label: Appliance and cleaning management
goal_classes.rationale: The automation monitors a 3D printer (an appliance) and notifies the user when a print job is complete. The user-facing purpose is to inform about the appliance's cycle status.

action_modalities.label: Notification and messaging
action_modalities.rationale: The action sends the message '3D Print Complete' through an anonymized textual notification channel.

automation.yaml:
- id: example_automation_002
  alias: Air Quality - Alert for Good Conditions
  initial_state: true
  trigger:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: input_select.example_air_quality_state
    to: Good
  actions:
  - action: script.example_air_purifier_auto

natural_language.trigger: When the example air quality state [input_select.example_air_quality_state] changes to 'Good'.

functional.human_like: When the air quality is reported as good, it automatically runs a script to set the air purifier to auto mode.
functional.structured_description: TRIGGER: When example air quality state [input_select.example_air_quality_state] changes to Good. CONDITIONS: None. ACTIONS: Execute script example_air_purifier_auto.

security.description: The automation only adjusts an indoor appliance based on environmental data. It does not expose personal data, affect physical security, or introduce cybersecurity risks.

goal_classes.label: Environmental comfort
goal_classes.rationale: The automation triggers when the air quality state becomes 'Good' and runs a script to set the air purifier to auto mode. The purpose is to maintain or adjust indoor environmental comfort based on air quality.

action_modalities.label: Scene or routine activation
action_modalities.rationale: The automation's action is to run a predefined, anonymized air-purifier routine.

automation.yaml:
- alias: 'iOS: toggle example office lights'
  initial_state: true
  triggers:
  - trigger: event
    event_type: ios.action_fired
    event_data:
      actionName: Example Office
  actions:
  - action: light.toggle
    target:
      entity_id: light.example_office_lamps

natural_language.trigger: When the anonymized iOS action named 'Example Office' is triggered from a mobile device.
natural_language.action: Toggles the example office lamps [light.example_office_lamps] on or off.

functional.human_like: Toggles the office lights when the 'Example Office' action is tapped on an iOS device.
functional.structured_description: TRIGGER: When an iOS action named 'Example Office' is fired. CONDITIONS: None. ACTIONS: Toggle example office lamps [light.example_office_lamps].

security.description: The rule only toggles indoor lighting and is triggered manually via an iOS action. It does not expose personal data or affect any security-sensitive systems.

goal_classes.label: Lighting comfort
goal_classes.rationale: The automation toggles office lights in response to a user action, directly serving lighting convenience and comfort.

action_modalities.label: Device actuation
action_modalities.rationale: The automation directly changes the physical state of the office lights by toggling them on or off.
